violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for
violation_type.typical_finding: The caregivers were unaware that one child in their care was missing.

finding_variants.text: The caregivers were unaware that one child in their care was missing.
Two caregivers in the class were unclear about which children they were responsible for supervising.
A child was left unattended on the playground.
A caregiver did not know the children they were responsible for when they left a child in the restroom.

Caregivers failed to conduct their routine name to face checks when transitioning their class from the playground to the classroom, which resulted in a 2 year old child being left unsupervised on the playground for one mintue.
A caregiver responsible for a group of children ages 5-9 years old was unaware of the number of children responsible for. The caregiver stated 15, however 16 were present.
